The plate spans about 360 px, so at roughly 26 cm that works out to about 14 px per cm. The food mound is about 180 px wide, or roughly 12 cm, and about 150 px tall, or roughly 10 cm. It looks like rice, or a rice and shrimp mixture, topped with a green salsa and diced tomato.

The pile is fairly low, perhaps 3 cm high at its peak. That gives a volume of around 150-200 ml. Cooked rice at about 0.7 g/ml comes to roughly 130 g, and the salsa and vegetables add some more, so I estimate about 150 g in total.

At about 1.4 kcal/g for a rice dish with some oil, the total is roughly 210 kcal. I'll round up slightly to 220 kcal.
